scientific_integrity: All-dimensional derivation is algebraic with an explicit quartic sum-of-squares identity; finite exact-arithmetic diagnostics are supporting checks, not replacements for its proof. All authorship and publication claims are confined to cited prior works.
scientific_limitations: Real coefficients, independent uniform signs, full degree-two Walsh chaos, and dimensions n>=6 only.

title: Sharp fourth moments and Euclidean distortion of complete quadratic Walsh chaoses
